name: FastPeopleSearch
instructions: Search fastpeoplesearch.com for {full_name}. If you're listed, open fastpeoplesearch.com/optout and follow the steps to remove your record; you may need to solve a CAPTCHA. If it asks for an email address, use {contact_email}, so OpenOptOut can click any confirmation link for you. Then press "I've done this".
source: Process per BADBOOL's FastPeopleSearch entry (search, then the opt-out page; may need a CAPTCHA).
